enchantments.tooltip: Wisdom +14: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +15 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Divine Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower Divine spells by two.
Quality Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Quality bonus to the DC of all spells.
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
